aboutSubheading: Crafting premium concrete solutions across inner Melbourne
aboutText: Based at 5 Frederick St in Northcote, Rutso Concrete has been delivering architectural concrete solutions to homes and businesses across Melbourne's inner north. From exposed aggregate driveways to polished concrete floors and decorative feature walls, we bring precision and craftsmanship to every pour. Our team understands Northcote's mix of heritage and modern architecture, tailoring each project to complement your property's unique character.
servicesText: Rutso Concrete provides a full range of architectural and decorative concrete services across Northcote and the inner northern suburbs. From residential driveways to commercial flooring, we deliver precision finishes built to last.

services.title: Exposed Aggregate
services.desc: Durable and visually striking exposed aggregate finishes for driveways, paths and outdoor entertaining areas across Northcote.

services.title: Polished Concrete
services.desc: High-gloss and matte polished concrete flooring for homes, cafes and retail spaces throughout Melbourne's inner north.

services.title: Concrete Driveways
services.desc: Custom-designed driveways with decorative edging, colour options and finishes that boost your Northcote property's street appeal.

services.title: Concrete Slabs and Foundations
services.desc: Engineered slabs and foundations for extensions, garages, sheds and new builds across Northcote and surrounding suburbs.

services.title: Decorative Concrete
services.desc: Stencilled, stamped and coloured concrete solutions that add personality to patios, pool surrounds and garden paths.

services.title: Architectural Concrete Features
services.desc: Bespoke concrete benchtops, retaining walls and feature panels designed to complement Northcote's modern and heritage homes.

testimonialsSubheading: Trusted by homeowners and businesses alike

reviews.text: Rutso Concrete did an incredible job on our exposed aggregate driveway in Northcote. The finish is flawless and they finished right on schedule. Could not be happier with the result and the price was very fair.
reviews.name: Sarah Mitchell

reviews.text: We needed polished concrete flooring for our new cafe fit-out and Rutso delivered a stunning result. Professional from start to finish, and they worked around our trading hours without any drama.
reviews.name: James O'Brien

reviews.text: I manage several properties in the inner north and have used Rutso for concrete repairs and full replacements. They are reliable, their workmanship is top-notch, and they always leave the site clean.
reviews.name: Karen Patel
